signals.title: BFCache diagnostics
signals.invariant: Generated UltraModern files must not install beforeunload or unload handlers.

signals.title: Core Web Vitals/RUM readiness
signals.invariant: UltraModern preset telemetry must remain enabled by default without requiring local collectors.

signals.title: Duplicate prefetch/warmup waste
signals.invariant: Generated route URLs, remote refs, and manifest URLs must stay deterministic and duplicate-free.

signals.title: Cache policy sanity
signals.invariant: Generated Cloudflare contracts must retain CSS cache-control and public-surface cache expectations.

signals.title: Save-Data behavior
signals.invariant: Automatic framework warmup must remain skippable by browser Save-Data policy.

signals.title: Cloudflare SSR response and caching hints
signals.invariant: Generated Cloudflare SSR proof routes and response/cache hint contracts must be present.

contentSecurityPolicy.reason: Report-only by default so Cloudflare Module Federation SSR can prove remote script, style, and connect compatibility before enforcement.

csp.decision: Report-only remains the generated final mode until public smoke proof records MF SSR script/style/connect compatibility for the deployed surface.
